name: Maryland Community Solar
old_description: Join Maryland Community Solar and save 5% to 25% on your electric bill.
about:
Maryland Community Solar operates from Columbia, Maryland, as a locally owned, family-run enterprise led by CEO Tony Napolitano. The company was established to educate Maryland residents and businesses about community solar programs and to simplify enrollment in those programs.

The firm provides consumer education on the benefits of community solar, assesses eligibility, and guides customers through the enrollment process. A customer relations team works directly with homeowners, renters, and businesses, including those served by third-party energy suppliers, to explain how subscription to a local solar farm can reduce electric bills by 5% to 25%. The company reports assisting hundreds of customers across the state.

Services are directed at Maryland residential and commercial utility customers who cannot install rooftop panels, such as condominium dwellers, as well as businesses seeking renewable energy credits. The company coordinates with solar developers and utility providers to facilitate the subscription and billing process.

The organization states its mission is to make Maryland a leader in sustainability and renewable energy through honest communication, leading by example, and caring for customers and communities.
